admission.workflow: Present Proctor's native ButtonControl with VS Code Modern UI text-button geometry, states and radius tier. The AuthenticatedWindow frame is Proctor-owned and no longer transfers the floating-panel shell.

items.rationale: Preserve toolbar hover fill, active fill, disabled exclusion and inset dashed hover outline in Proctor-owned button states. Keyboard focus retains its owning solid focus indicator.

Text-button geometry, regular typography, secondary border fallback, hover colors, focus offset and disabled opacity on the existing native ButtonControl interface. The source Modern UI control-radius tier applies. Split/dropdown, markdown and short-label buttons remain in the already admitted source Button cluster; they are not selected by this interface. Adds a Proctor brand variant that follows the color.brand roles.

dependencies.rationale: Existing theme service supplies the packaged catalog, four scheme classifications, density and preference lifecycle consumed by the button styles.

divergences.summary: The existing native button interface keeps submit, disabled and busy semantics, intrinsic width, large Launch size and danger variant. Default text-button presentation follows the pinned source; source control dimensions are local geometry. Adds a Proctor brand variant that follows the color.brand roles.

verification.obligation: Account page loading, failure, menu actions, confirmation/cancellation, focus, disposal and constrained-width behavior through the production pane.
Compare the button states with the recorded upstream Modern UI in the native Electron window. Record unavailable platform/screen-reader release evidence without claiming pixel identity.
Resolve every source blob at the pinned revision and inspect adapted differences.
